services.desc: The Laughing Skull Lounge Stand Up comedy class is a six week comedy course that ends with a graduation show! We apply lessons from the best comedians in the country and help you create a solid 5-8 minute set to use as you wish. We sell out almost every class, so if you are interested, we suggest you sign up now! Classes are on Saturdays from 10:00 am to 1:00 pm at the world famous Laughing Skull Lounge. Plug Chapman has been a working Stand-up comedian for over 10 years and can be seen on Comedy Central and TruTV.
